tagline.en: Three-powered UK MVNO — £6 PAYG eSIM, keep alive with one event per 90 days
tagline.zh: 走Three网络的英国虚商——6英镑Paygo eSIM，每90天一次使用即保号

description.en: iD Mobile is a London-based MVNO (founded 2014) running on Three's network, known for flexible, value plans. Its £6 pay-as-you-go eSIM bundles unlimited calls and texts with 1GB of data; the SIM expires after 90 days of inactivity (per the official FAQ), and the T&C adds automatic disconnection after 4 months with no chargeable service, top-up or bundle purchase.
description.zh: iD Mobile是2014年成立于伦敦的英国虚商，走Three网络，以灵活高性价比著称。其6英镑Paygo eSIM含无限通话短信与1GB流量；90天无使用SIM即失效（官方FAQ口径），条款另有：4个月无计费服务、充值或购包将自动断开。

details.en:
iD Mobile is the low-cost way onto Three's UK network (the network now merged with Vodafone UK, though integration is ongoing): £6 pay-as-you-go buys unlimited UK calls and texts plus 1GB — usable as a keep-alive base with light real usage.

Keep-alive bar: the official FAQ says the SIM expires after 90 days of inactivity, and the T&C adds automatic disconnection after 4 months with no chargeable service, top-up or bundle purchase — stricter than the 180-day networks (giffgaff/VOXI), not more relaxed. Monthly plans and PAYG both exist; eSIM is selectable at checkout.

Trade-offs common to budget MVNOs apply: traffic priority sits below Three's own subscribers, and the source review groups iD with the budget-MVNO tier — fine for a cheap UK number, not the first pick for mainland-China roaming reliability.
details.zh:
iD Mobile 是登上 Three 英国网络的低价途径（该网络已与 Vodafone 英国完成合并，整合仍在进行中）：6 英镑的 Pay as you go 套餐包含英国本地无限通话与短信外加 1GB 流量，可以当作「保号底座+轻度使用」的组合。

保号门槛：官方 FAQ 明确 90 天无使用 SIM 即失效，条款进一步规定 4 个月内无计费服务、充值或购包将自动断开——比 giffgaff、VOXI 的 180 天窗口更严格，并非更宽松。月付套餐与 Paygo 并存，结账时可直接勾选 eSIM。

低价虚商的共性取舍同样适用于它：流量优先级低于 Three 本网用户，高峰期或拥挤区域可能被调度挤压；源盘点将 iD 归入低价虚商梯队——适合低成本持有英国号码的场景，但不是中国大陆漫游稳定性的首选，云居民应优先考虑 giffgaff/CTExcel/CMLink 一类回国卡。

bestFor.en: Budget users wanting Three-network coverage who can keep up a 90-day keep-alive cadence (stricter than giffgaff/VOXI's 180 days).
bestFor.zh: 预算有限、想要Three网络覆盖且能坚持90天保号节奏的用户（比giffgaff/VOXI的180天更严）。

plansNote.zh: Paygo规则按iD Mobile官方FAQ/条款（2026-09复核）：90天不活动失效；4个月无计费事件断开。

country.en: GB (UK exit when roaming, home-routed via Three)
country.zh: GB (UK exit when roaming, home-routed via Three)

note.en: Runs on Three UK. ISPreview testing shows iD roaming traffic is routed back to a UK server (Mass Response) over a Tele2 transit APN, i.e. UK exit; an iD community post only surfaced a UK IP mis-geolocated to the Isle of Man (database quirk).
note.zh: 走 Three 英国网。ISPreview 实测显示 iD 漫游流量经 Tele2 中转 APN 回到英国服务器（Mass Response）出口；iD 社区一帖只是英国 IP 被地理库误标为马恩岛。
